The first Milestone was dedicated to creating the design and preparing for the start of development:
Design:
mobile/desktop design - https://www.figma.com/file/9UNrr2Q322YBYvfrTXHrM3/easy-speak-PoA1-Fund11?type=design&node-id=0-1&mode=design

Development:
link for vercel website - https://easy-speak-theta.vercel.app/en

This is what the design looks like now. During the development of the service, there may be changes in the design: adding additional functionality, changing the appearance of elements, and some elements may disappear.
But the key functionality declared in the final Milestone will remain entirely:
・the user can register for the service
・the user can book a training session
・the user can view lists of teachers and schedules
・the user can apply to “become a teacher”
・user can connect his wallet to the website

4 month (Smart Contracts)

・Smart contracts on-chain code (Smart contracts will be written)
・Smart contract off-chain code (These smart contracts will connect to the service)
